text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Speed Symboli showed how high 
the wall of the world stood—now, a 
Japanese Umamusume has finally reached its 
summit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dreams of the Umamusume who 
continuously challenged the world, the 
feelings of the comrades who strove 
together, and the expectations of all the 
supporters across Japan—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Combining all of that, Team Japan built a 
bridge to the pinnacle of the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And once again, dreaming of reaching the 
pinnacle of the world, new Umamusume and 
Trainers knock on the doors of Project 
L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Now, let us claim victory. At the 
upcoming Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
